items.text: Becoming a virtual assistant in India starts with a narrow set of tasks you can do reliably, such as inbox handling, scheduling, data entry or social posting, and grows through clear packages, a few honest first clients and written processes that let you take on more work.
Pick two or three tasks, do three trial pieces of work, find first clients through people you know and refer to written checklists so quality stays steady.
Check current rules and use written agreements.
